findings.title: npm run report presents the report of an earlier release build when the latest release build failed in the prebuild step
findings.location: site/src/lib/unverifiedRegistry.ts:208-211 (the report is reset only at astro:build:start); package.json:15 (prebuild runs katex-assets.mjs, names.mjs and presets.mjs before Astro starts); scripts/report.mjs:36-41 (accepts any report with complete: true)
findings.claim: The fix of P4-RT-12-04 marks the report incomplete when the Astro build starts and while the postbuild link check runs. A release build that fails in the prebuild never reaches Astro, so the previous release build's report stays complete and npm run report exits 0 with it.
findings.expected: DECISIONS.md 'RT-FIX-P4-toolchain: the postbuild holds the release report (P4-RT-12-04)': 'a release build is prebuild, the Astro build and the postbuild, and a failed release build is never presented as the release report'. SPEC 7.3: a release build 'prints a report of the open items and the pages that use them'; 7.7: npm run report gives 'the two content reports'. So after a failed RELEASE=1 npm run build, npm run report should exit 1, as it does after a postbuild failure.
findings.observed: 1. RELEASE=1 npm run build: exit 0; report complete, generatedAt 2026-10-25T04:56:01.571Z. 2. Added <Unverified item="E4"> to M8 and a syntax error in packages/engine/src/rep.ts. 3. RELEASE=1 npm run build: exit 1 in the prebuild (presets.mjs: SyntaxError [ERR_INVALID_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX]). 4. npm run report: exit 0, 'report: open items report of 2026-10-25T04:56:01.571Z: 8 open items used on 9 pages, 0 unknown items'. The report still says complete: true, and E4's pages are /modules/m1-mutation/, /modules/m3-classification/ and /open-problem/, without /modules/m8-lie-algebras/, where the sources now use E4.

findings.specRef: SPEC.md 7.3 (<Unverified>, the release report), 7.7 (npm run report); DECISIONS.md RT-FIX-P4-toolchain (P4-RT-12-04)
findings.proposedFix: Make the first step of every release build command mark an existing report incomplete before anything can fail. For example, scripts/katex-assets.mjs, the first prebuild step, calls the openItemsReport.mjs writer when RELEASE is set. Alternatively, report.mjs could compare the report's buildId with a marker that the prebuild writes.
